title: Flow Matching vs. Diffusion: Why Continuous Normalizing Flows Are Replacing Score-Based Models
lead: Standard diffusion models require 50 to 100 denoising steps through complex stochastic differential equations. Flow Matching straightens probability trajectories, cutting sampling steps by 80% while retaining generative quality.

stats.title: Generative Efficiency Metrics:
items: Optimal Transport Flow Matching achieves parity with standard score-based diffusion in only 10 to 16 Euler steps.
Straight-line trajectories eliminate trajectory curvature, reducing inference latency from 3.2 seconds down to 420 milliseconds on NVIDIA H100 GPUs.

mentalModel.title: 1. The 60-Second Mental Model: Curved Drifts vs. Straight Highways
mentalModel.text:
Traditional diffusion pushes random noise particles along curved paths with unpredictable brownian drift. Flow Matching defines a direct velocity vector pointing from pure Gaussian noise directly to the target data distribution.

Straight trajectories allow deterministic numerical ODE solvers to take large, accurate steps without veering off course.

graph LR
    Noise["Gaussian Noise Distribution N(0, I)"] --> OT["Optimal Transport Velocity Field"]
    OT --> Step1["Euler Step 1 (t=0.2)"]
    Step1 --> Step2["Euler Step 2 (t=0.6)"]
    Step2 --> Data["Reconstructed Data Distribution (t=1.0)"]

diagramCaption: Figure 9: Deterministic Straight-Path Trajectories in Flow Matching
codeContent:
# Minimal Euler Solver for Flow Matching
def flow_matching_sample(model, noise_latents, steps=10):
    dt = 1.0 / steps
    x = noise_latents
    for i in range(steps):
        t = torch.full((x.shape[0],), i * dt, device=x.device)
        velocity = model(x, t)
        x = x + velocity * dt
    return x

takeaway.title: Key Takeaways
items: Optimal Transport vectors straighten the generation path between noise and high-fidelity output.
Reduced step counts directly cut real-time serving infrastructure costs.
Deterministic ODE samplers produce predictable, reproducible inference latencies.
takeaway.badge: Flow matching bridges continuous physics and generative AI with predictable sample trajectories.

title: Mamba and Selective State-Space Models: Breaking the Attention Quadratic Bottleneck
lead: Transformer self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length, causing memory limits at 128k+ contexts. Selective State-Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba process arbitrary length sequences with linear complexity.

stats.title: Sequence Scaling Benchmarks:
items: Self-attention memory footprints scale O(N^2) as sequence lengths grow beyond 64k tokens.
Selective SSMs maintain a constant-size hidden state, achieving up to 5x higher inference throughput on 100k+ token document processing.

mentalModel.title: 1. The 60-Second Mental Model: Constant-Size Memory vs. Growing History
mentalModel.text:
A standard Transformer keeps every past token in its KV-cache, demanding more RAM with every token generated. An SSM continuously updates a fixed-size internal state matrix, choosing which signals to remember and which to discard.

Selective scan turns the recurrent state update into an input-dependent filter that trains in parallel and serves in constant memory.

diagram:
graph TD
    Tokens["Input Token Stream x_t"] --> Selective["Selective Scan Gate: B(x), C(x), delta(x)"]
    Selective --> Hidden["Constant Hidden State h_t = A*h_(t-1) + B*x_t"]
    Hidden --> Out["Output Prediction y_t = C*h_t"]
    style Tokens fill:#1e293b,stroke:#64748b,color:#fff
    style Hidden fill:#065f46,stroke:#10b981,color:#fff
codeContent:
# Conceptual Selective Scan Update
def selective_scan_step(h_prev, x_t, A, B_t, C_t, delta_t):
    # Input-dependent discretization
    A_bar = torch.exp(delta_t * A)
    B_bar = delta_t * B_t
    h_next = A_bar * h_prev + B_bar * x_t
    y_t = C_t * h_next
    return h_next, y_t

takeaway.title: Key Takeaways
items: Linear time complexity unlocks unbounded sequence context lengths without quadratic memory explosions.
Hardware-aware scan kernels fuse state updates into high-speed SRAM, avoiding GPU DRAM bottlenecks.
Hybrid Transformer-SSM models blend precise recall with linear generation efficiency.
takeaway.badge: Sub-quadratic architectures transform long-context processing from a hardware bottleneck into an engineering reality.
